files_modified.description: Removed CLIFF_PRE_PEAK_PLATEAU_SECONDS and CLIFF_PRE_PEAK_TOLERANCE_C from CURVE_DETECTION_CONFIG. Updated rationale comment for Stance B.

Removed _cliff_pre_plateau_s and _cliff_pre_peak_tol_c from __init__. Simplified _candidate_probe_pull_cliff to remove plateau-duration guard. Added min_peak_temp guard to filter cascade-ambient cliffs. Added grace-window fallback for cliffs at peak_idx (short logs). In _evaluate_exit_candidates, scan cliff from peak_idx+1 to avoid false cliff at the running peak itself.

verification.grep_CLIFF_PRE_PEAK: No live code matches — only a prose reference in a comment.

verification.pytest_full_suite: 135 passed / 8 failed / 1 skipped — matches Defender baseline, no new regressions

surprises.description: real_1000BA3C_1759 contains TWO cliffs within bake-1's scan window: j=293 (peak=93.75C at 1465s, the first probe insertion) and j=944 (peak=97.80C at 4720s, the real bake-1 endpoint). Removing the CLIFF_PRE_PEAK guard naively fires the j=293 cliff, ending bake-1 at 293 instead of 944.
surprises.resolution: Two-part fix: (1) In _evaluate_exit_candidates, cliff scans from peak_idx+1 (not peak_idx) — this prevents the cliff at j=peak_idx from firing in the main loop and relies on the grace-window fallback for short-log cases (0946, synthetic). (2) Added min_peak_temp temperature guard so cascade cliffs below 80C (j=294, 295, etc.) are suppressed. The j=293 cliff in 1759 is not reached via main loop (peak_idx+1=294 starts scan after it) and not via grace fallback (n-1=6213 >> peak_idx+grace=303). The j=944 cliff fires correctly via the main loop at j=954.
